name: Doge Academy
source:
Doge Academy is an open source visual novel featuring the famous Doge meme attending an all-shibe school in Tokyo.

The catch? You actually learn how Dogecoin works! Navigate your way through high school as a dog and make friends along the way.
translation:
Doge Academy是一款开源视觉小说，以就读于东京一所全士学校的著名Doge meme为特色。

收获是什么？你实际上了解了狗狗币的工作原理！像一只狗一样度过高中，并一路上结交朋友。
